hypothesis: Reversible lithium intercalation in graphite and LiCoO2 enables safer rechargeable battery operation compared to lithium metal
prediction: The cycle life of a lithium battery using graphite anode and LiCoO2 cathode will be at least 10 times longer than a lithium metal battery
measurement_method: Count the number of complete charge-discharge cycles until capacity drops to 80% of initial capacity for both battery types
falsification_condition: If the lithium metal battery achieves cycle life within the range of 5-20 times that of the graphite/LiCoO2 battery
